question: From an interior point of an equilateral triangle, three perpendiculars are drawn to its three sides which are of lengths 12.7 cm, 14.8 cm and 11.5 cm, respectively. Find the area of the equilateral triangle.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In an equilateral triangle, sum of perpendiculars from any interior point = altitude

Altitude = 12.7 + 14.8 + 11.5 = 39 cm

Side = (2 × altitude) / √3 = (2 × 39)/√3 = 78/√3 = 26√3

Area = (√3/4) × side²

= (√3/4) × (26√3)² = (√3/4) × 2028 = 507√3

**∴ Answer = 507√3 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perpendiculars = 12.7 cm, 14.8 cm, 11.5 cm

**Formula used:**

Altitude of equilateral triangle = sum of perpendiculars from any interior point

Area = (√3/4) × side²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Altitude = 12.7 + 14.8 + 11.5 = 39 cm

⇒ For equilateral triangle:

Altitude = (√3/2) × side

⇒ side = (2 × 39)/√3 = 26√3

⇒ Area = (√3/4) × (26√3)²

⇒ = (√3/4) × 2028

⇒ = 507√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 507√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Key Property

Sum of perpendiculars = altitude in equilateral triangle

Altitude Formula

h = (√3/2) × side

Area Formula

(√3/4) × side²

Key Insight

Convert altitude to side before area
